# TreeDropPosition

`Flare.Components.TreeDropPosition`

Position where an item is dropped relative to the target.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Before` | `0` | Dropped before the target item. |
| `After` | `1` | Dropped after the target item. |
| `Inside` | `2` | Dropped inside the target item (as a child). |
